title: Generate downloadable ZIP build artifacts for the Speed Motors ERP

requirements.text: Ensure the project produces ZIP artifacts for the Speed Motors ERP and stages them as static files served by the frontend at /artifacts/ so the user can download them from the running app.

quotes: MUY IMPORTANTE: Utiliza la herramienta de la IA para empaquetar todos estos archivos en un documento .ZIP descargable aquí mismo en el chat para que yo lo guarde en mi PC.

acceptanceCriteria: Running the existing packaging workflow generates both frontend/public/artifacts/app-build.zip and frontend/public/artifacts/source-code.zip (and stages frontend/public/artifacts/SOURCE_CODE.md).
When the app is running, HEAD/GET requests to /artifacts/app-build.zip, /artifacts/source-code.zip, and /artifacts/SOURCE_CODE.md return 200 responses (when artifacts have been generated).
The artifacts contain the expected contents per the packaging script: compiled backend canister output, frontend dist build, and included documentation/source code bundle as applicable.

requirements.text: Add a user-visible download UI in the Speed Motors ERP that lets the user download the generated ZIP files (app-build.zip and source-code.zip) and the SOURCE_CODE.md file, with clear statuses when files are not yet available.

quotes: MUY IMPORTANTE: Utiliza la herramienta de la IA para empaquetar todos estos archivos en un documento .ZIP descargable aquí mismo en el chat para que yo lo guarde en mi PC.

acceptanceCriteria: The UI includes a clearly labeled section or dialog (reachable from the main layout) with download links/buttons for: /artifacts/app-build.zip, /artifacts/source-code.zip, and /artifacts/SOURCE_CODE.md.
The UI uses the existing static artifact availability check (HEAD-based) to show whether each artifact is available, and disables/hides download actions when unavailable.
Clicking an available download link triggers a browser download for the corresponding artifact file.

requirements.text: Complete the included DEPLOY_README.md so that the ZIP build artifact has usable, English deployment instructions for extracting and deploying the packaged build.

quotes: MUY IMPORTANTE: Utiliza la herramienta de la IA para empaquetar todos estos archivos en un documento .ZIP descargable aquí mismo en el chat para que yo lo guarde en mi PC.

acceptanceCriteria: frontend/artifacts/DEPLOY_README.md contains step-by-step, English instructions describing what app-build.zip includes, how to extract it, and how to deploy/run it using the Internet Computer tooling expected by this project.
DEPLOY_README.md is included at the root of app-build.zip (as currently intended by the packaging script).

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo; only use backend/migration.mo if a persisted schema/state upgrade is required.
Do not modify any files under frontend/src/components/ui or other paths listed in frontend.immutablePaths.
Do not introduce non-supported stacks (no Python/Flask/SQLite).
nonGoals: Implementing a Flask/SQLite version of the ERP.
Adding new ERP modules or changing existing business logic unrelated to packaging/downloading artifacts.
Adding external storage, third-party hosting, or non-IC deployment targets.
